rounds.text: Sodhani Capital demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, evidenced by an ROCE of 25.0% and an ROE of 18.6% [E12, E13], both of which significantly outperform their respective sector benchmarks of 5.12% and 4.81% [E9, E10]. The company maintains a pristine balance sheet, having successfully reduced its borrowings to zero [E29, E38, E39]. This operational strength is supported by a robust 3-year compounded sales growth of 24% and profit growth of 25% [E14, E16]. Furthermore, the business exhibits high-quality earnings, with cash conversion at 1.03x, ensuring that reported profits are fully backed by operating cash flow [E24]. A discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 121 per share, providing a substantial 40.1% margin of safety against the current market price [E33, E34]. Conceded: the stock is currently trading at only 24% of its 52-week range [E5] and free cash flow was negative at Rs -4.04 Cr in March 2026 [E26].
